pages.text: The disc's spin collapses suddenly. It happens when the stabilizers snap back at high spin, or a stabilizer runs out of mass while spinning.$(br2)The trapped energy dumps into the core and a $(num)60 second$() timer starts.
pages.title: Disc Stall

pages.text: Press $(thing)Jump$() while the console shows $(good)NOW!$(). The window opens every 4 seconds.$(br2)Missing it costs 10 seconds and adds backlash. If the timer runs out: $(danger)pre-meltdown$().
pages.title: Recovering a stall

pages.text: Spinning above $(num)4,000 rpm$() builds ring stress. Lower the offset to let it cool.$(br2)At $(num)100%$() the ring fails: $(danger)pre-meltdown$().
pages.title: Overspin

pages.text: Below $(num)10,000$() total mass, stability drops. Refuel or shut down.$(br2)Below $(num)4,000$() the core can't be held: $(danger)pre-meltdown$().
pages.title: Mass Starvation

pages.text: Breaking any part of the structure while the reactor runs sends it straight to $(danger)pre-meltdown$().$(br2)Put the block back fast.
pages.title: Containment Breach
